# Get-ZbxDiscoveryRulePrototype

## SYNOPSIS

Gets the discovery rule prototypes that discovery rules create for what they find.

## DESCRIPTION

A discovery rule prototype is a discovery rule that a parent discovery rule creates for each entity it finds, for nested discovery (Zabbix 7.4 and later). The Get-ZbxDiscoveryRulePrototype cmdlet reads them with discoveryruleprototype.get: all of them up to -Limit, by name with -Name (* and ? are wildcards), by id with -Id or from the pipeline, or with the whole discoveryruleprototype.get selection in -Filter. -Group, -Template, -Host and the other object filters narrow the result to the discovery rule prototypes of the objects given, each a name, an id or a piped object. It writes ZabbixDiscoveryRulePrototype objects, with their related objects when a -Select switch asks for them, or, with -CountOutput, the number of matches; it needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Get a discovery rule prototype by name

```powershell
Get-ZbxDiscoveryRulePrototype -Name 'Databases on {#INSTANCE}'
```

Gets the discovery rule prototype named Databases on {#INSTANCE}. A * or ? in -Name makes it a search, so -Name 'Databases*' gets every discovery rule prototype whose name starts with Databases.

### Example 2: Get the discovery rule prototypes of a host

```powershell
Get-ZbxDiscoveryRulePrototype -Host 'web-01'
```

Gets the discovery rule prototypes of the host web-01. -Host takes a name, an id or an object; a host piped from Get-ZbxHost binds to it by its HostId property.

### Example 3: Search discovery rule prototypes with a filter

```powershell
Get-ZbxDiscoveryRulePrototype -Filter @{ search = @{ name = 'Databases' }; limit = 10 }
```

-Filter takes the whole discoveryruleprototype.get selection, keyed by the API's field names: here at most ten discovery rule prototypes whose name contains Databases.
